info.title: Domino law-firm integration API
info.description: Local single-tenant demo. SQLite synthetic/read-only; generic push accepts annotations, not legal confirmation. API access required; consumer subscriptions insufficient. Export response only, no external write.

bearerAuth.description: DOMINO_INTEGRATION_KEY on server; unset fails closed.

Matter.description: 1 MB body; 500000 total document characters. Unique IDs, valid dates, matching quotes and cross references required. Built-in case and library IDs reserved. No confirmation, SQL, path, URL, verified or credential fields.

AnalysisRequest.description: ai-review requires profileId; deterministic rejects it. One bounded model request for commentary; not full fresh extraction.
